question: Should ClawHub adopt compatibility-preserving duplicate-case rejection now, including PROTOCOL.md collision enforcement, once this branch is rebased?
rationale: The implementation shape is coherent and proven, but it deliberately rejects packages that currently pass and extends validation to a partly undocumented package-file scope.

options.title: Rebase and adopt this policy
options.body: Confirm the compatibility boundary, preserve staged publish behavior during rebase, and continue toward merge after conflict resolution.

options.title: Narrow to readme collisions
options.body: Ask the PR to reject only SKILL.md, skill.md, and skills.md collisions until PROTOCOL.md is explicitly documented as a package contract.

options.title: Defer policy enforcement
options.body: Keep the linked issue open for a docs, migration, and content-cleanup plan before changing publish/import acceptance.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt this policy
recommendation.body: Confirm the compatibility boundary, preserve staged publish behavior during rebase, and continue toward merge after conflict resolution.
